name: kilobat
title: Kilobat
description: See which apps use the network, check Wi-Fi and latency, find why a site won't load, test speed and keep your Mac awake. Uses the free Kilobat CLI.
author: seifip

commands.name: network-apps
commands.title: Network Apps
commands.subtitle: Kilobat
commands.description: Live download and upload speed per app, updated every two seconds.

commands.name: network-status
commands.title: Network Status
commands.subtitle: Kilobat
commands.description: Wi-Fi signal, internet latency and loss, VPN, metered network and power at a glance.

commands.name: why
commands.title: Why Can't I Reach
commands.subtitle: Kilobat
commands.description: Checks a site or host layer by layer and names the one that fails: network, proxy, DNS, rules, connection or server.

commands.name: speed-test
commands.title: Speed Test
commands.subtitle: Kilobat
commands.description: Download, upload, latency under load, and whether calls and streaming will hold up.

commands.name: keep-awake
commands.title: Keep Awake
commands.subtitle: Kilobat
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake for a while, until downloads finish or while an app is in front, with the same choices as Kilobat's teacup.

tools.name: get-network-status
tools.title: Get Network Status
tools.description: Returns the Mac's current network: Wi-Fi name, signal and band, internet latency and packet loss, VPN, whether the network is metered or in Low Data Mode, keep-awake state, battery and heat.

tools.name: get-network-apps
tools.title: Get Network Apps
tools.description: Returns the apps and processes using the network right now, with download and upload speed and bytes moved this session, busiest first.

tools.name: check-host
tools.title: Check Host
tools.description: Checks why a URL or host can or can't be reached from this Mac. Returns a verdict and each layer's result: network, interface, proxy, DNS, Kilobat rules, IPv4, IPv6 and server.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Kilobat CLI Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to find kilobat in Homebrew's bin folders.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

Publish to the Raycast Store with npm run publish, not npm publish.

" && exit 1

ai.instructions: Kilobat reads this Mac's live network state through the local kilobat CLI. Prefer check-host for any question about a site, API or host failing; get-network-status for Wi-Fi, latency, VPN or metered questions; get-network-apps for what is using bandwidth. Bytes are decimal (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes). Say what you measured and avoid guessing about causes the results don't show.
